== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[URoRRuR'R'R (Japanese)|URoRRuR'R'R]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/160005381/slupHqWs0ESsZnKm9M1Esw.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 93071765.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>1ad9b4c24371fd3b5d8a2c62c324ef9d62131a74c84636d949d99768bf703a0b</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
